config.slot.name: dbz_odoo_down
config.publication.name: dbz_odoo_owned
config.heartbeat.action.query: INSERT INTO public.dbz_heartbeat (id, ts) VALUES (1, now()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ts = EXCLUDED.ts
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.//down: Sends down only the tables in sync/hub-down.conf: register-odoo.sh fills the table list and the aggregate regex from that list, and refuses to register when it cannot. The publication it reads (dbz_odoo_owned) holds the same tables, with a row filter on each table that has an id.
config.//origin: Decodes only what was written at this hub. A row a clinic's up-sink applied here carries that clinic's replication origin and is skipped, so the hub never publishes one clinic's rows to another clinic or back to the clinic that sent them.
